name: same-session-computer-use
description: Add exact background capture and window-targeted input for Codex on Hyprland.

interface.longDescription: Extends the bundled Computer Use plugin on Hyprland with exact background window capture, targeted shortcuts, and window-local click, scroll, and drag controls. It preserves existing application processes, profiles, files, signed-in state, physical pointer, focus, and workspace during normal targeted operations.
defaultPrompt: Use my existing logged-in app to complete this task in the background.
Show me an exact screenshot of one of my real application windows.
Operate this app without moving my pointer or changing my workspace.
